candidates.change_summary: Replace withdrawAll body to call withdraw with zero instead of full balance, so withdrawAll transfers 0 instead of contract balance.
Replace withdrawAll body to directly transfer 0 to caller instead of transferring the contract balance, so withdrawAll transfers nothing.
Replace withdrawAll body to call withdraw with address(this).balance + 1 (may revert due to insufficient funds or change behavior), so attempted transfer amount differs.
Replace onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender is not the owner (inverts check), causing withdrawAll to be callable only by non-owners and changing observed behavior.
Replace onlyOwner modifier to remove the require check (no restriction), allowing withdrawAll to be called by anyone and thus changing observable behavior.
Replace transfer to send with return-value check: use payable(msg.sender).send(_value) and revert if it returns false (changes gas/behavior on failure).
Replace transfer with low-level call returning success flag and ignore revert bubbling (call instead of transfer).
Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender equals owner OR allow if value zero (relaxes guard when no ETH is being withdrawn).
Make withdraw send zero instead of requested _value (causes different observed withdrawn amount).
Replace the call-with-return handling to ignore the returned success and data and always attempt a low-level call without checking result, removing revert on failure.
Invert the success check so that the call reverts when the low-level call SUCCEEDS, causing sendMoney to revert on successful transfers instead of on failures.
Change the onlyOwner modifier to require that msg.sender is NOT owner, flipping the access control so sendMoney can be called only by non-owners.
